_readme: This file is the About page. Edit it, drop images in public/about/, and
the page updates — no code change needed.
PHOTOS: put the original files in public/about/ at whatever size your
camera produced. `npm run build` resizes them (or run
`node scripts/optimise_photos.mjs` on its own). Never reference anything
in public/about/opt/ — that folder is generated.
PLACE LINKS: `placeSlug` is the last part of a place URL. Open the pin on
the map and copy it out of the address bar — /place/THIS-BIT/. The build
checks every slug and tells you if one doesn't exist, so a typo becomes a
warning rather than a dead link.
Any section left empty renders as a marked placeholder rather than
disappearing, so you can see what's still missing.
